scope.fixed_owned_parser: two-byte debit with deliberately inserted underflow
scope.limits: A bounded native fuzzing and replay control on owned Python code. It does not establish exhaustive path coverage, native-extension sanitizer coverage, general vulnerability discovery ability, or equivalence of the release binary to the catalog commit.
scope.normalization: Fresh mutated corpus bytes, intermediate inputs, number of runs before a failure, coverage counts, timing, memory, native addresses and process IDs are excluded from the canonical result; every fresh witness is independently checked and replayed on original and repaired fixtures. The optional raw receipt retains those observations.
